violation_type.title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)
violation_type.short_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies
violation_type.typical_finding: One child's file was missing information on the parents receiving the operational policies.

finding_variants.text: One child's file was missing information on the parents receiving the operational policies.
Out of four children files reviewed one did not have the acknowledgment of receiving the operational policies.
1 out of 10 children's files evaluated was missing the signature from parents for receiving a copy of the operational policies.
Nine of the ten children's files reviewed did not include verification of receipt of the operational policies.
The operation policy was not available for review during the inspection.
During an inspection while reviewing files, it was observed one student was missing information over the operational policies.

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: The operation policy was not available for review during the inspection.

Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: The operation needs to include the following information in its policy: -How the operation will notify parents -Procedures for suspending or expelling a child. -How parents will be notified when changes are made to the operation policy. -Procedures for children's indoor and outdoor activities. -Parents' rights -Procedures for parental participation in operation activities. -Policies regarding vaccine-preventable diseases for employees. -How the operation will maintain and administer unassigned epinephrine. -Procedures for caring for children with special care needs.
